title: Music Enabled
script: Music sets the emotional tone of your video. [Visual: music notes]\nThe pipeline auto-fetches royalty-free CC0 music. [Visual: audio waveform]\nDucking automatically lowers music during speech. [Visual: volume meter]

title: Music Disabled
script: Voice-only mode is perfect for educational content. [Visual: teacher]\nNo background music means clear narration. [Visual: microphone]\nGreat for tutorials and explainer videos. [Visual: classroom]

title: Custom Music
script: You can use your own music file as background. [Visual: audio file]\nPlace any MP3 in the input/visuals folder. [Visual: file folder]\nThe pipeline will normalize and loop it automatically. [Visual: audio loop]
